transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As we all know, we have a state regulator's subpoena requesting company records related to the Orion procurement program, and our response deadline is June 30, 2026. The team has collected approximately 1,200 potentially responsive documents from the designated systems. Before I can give final approval to the production plan, we need to make sure we've resolved any identified scope, privacy, privilege, and insurance requirements per our subpoena-response protocol. I'd like to hear from each of you on where we stand. Who would like to begin?

decisions.production_scope: Approximately 1,200 potentially responsive documents collected from designated systems concerning the Orion procurement program, with 47 documents containing nonpublic manufacturing specifications and supplier pricing requiring protective-order treatment, 18 documents containing employee medical information requiring redaction of medical identifiers before production, and attorney-client legal advice to be withheld and identified on a privilege log while factual business records are produced.

commitments.detail: Production plan will include a protective-order motion before the 47 documents containing nonpublic manufacturing specifications and supplier pricing are produced.
The 18 documents containing employee medical information will be produced only after medical identifiers are redacted.

Production plan will include a privilege log for any attorney-client communications identified within the collected documents; factual business records will be produced while attorney-client legal advice will be withheld.
Production plan will include steps to provide written notice to and obtain written consent from the insurer before any records are produced.
Elena Morris will give final approval to the production plan once all scope, privacy, privilege, and insurance requirements are incorporated, ahead of the June 30, 2026 deadline.
